The proposed PV system, which includes a quadratic Boost converter and a P&O MPPT controller, must be implemented in a MATLAB/Simulink model and its performance evaluated under various environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Noniterative Parameter-free Fault Location Method in a Multi-Machine Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Accurate fault location estimation decreases the power outage time and the operating cost. Power grids have interconnected nature to improve power supply dependability and reduce plant reserve capacity. However, it makes the estimation of fault location difficult. Noniterative parameter free fault localization is an emerging method. The method locates the faults regardless of fault resistance, fault type, faulted line parameters and external network parameters. Method relies on measurements from all the terminals of the line of interest. However, its performance on interconnected system is still not fully explored. In this paper we analyse the performance of a noniterative parameter free fault localization method on an IEEE nine bus system. By measuring the voltage and current phasors at the sending and receiving ends of the faulted line before and during the fault, it is possible to pinpoint the exact position of the fault. To produce an exact closed-form estimation for fault location in medium or long transmission lines, consideration is given to the line shunt capacitance also. The system under study is realized in PSCAD/EMTDC software and results are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Ternary Full Adder designs using proposed Ternary 3:1 MUX
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel circuit design of a Ternary Full Adder (TFA) using a proposed Ternary 3:1 multiplexer (3:1 TMUX) and proposed Ternary Half Adder (THA). This research focuses on achieving low power consumption and propagation latency in these proposed circuits. The proposed Ternary Full Adder circuit is compared with existing circuits and demonstrates superior performance based on their performance metrics. The circuit analysis and simulations were conducted using Cadence Virtuoso design environment at 90 nm technology. The simulation results indicate that the proposed designs outperform other existing circuits in terms of latency and power-delay product (PDP) and are suitable for high-performance Ternary computational circuits.

articleTitle: Dual Source Vertical TFET Channel Overlapped Structure with Enhanced RF/Analog Performance for Low-Power- Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper emphasizes evaluating the structure and performance of a Dual Source Vertical Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor (DS-VTFET) at the device level. This involves the analysis of two different DS-VTFET structures: one with a channel overlapped and the other without a channel overlapped. The concept of an overlapped channel in DS-VTFET is introduced, showcasing how it enhances both DC performance and RF (radio frequency) device standards by improving gate modulation. The analysis conducted in this research involves studying the inherent capacitances of the device and evaluating figures of merit, such as transconductance (gm). The overlapped DS-VTFET demonstrates superior performance, including a high drive on current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>) = 1.20 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> A, reduced off-state current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf>) = 3.95 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> A, and a sub-threshold slope (SS) of 11mV/decade, and average subthreshold swing (AVSS)= 35.30 mV/decade, compared to the structure without channel overlapped structure which has I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON =</inf>9.89 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> A, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf>=2.96×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup>A, SS=12.77 mV/decade and AVSS=39.42 mV/decade. The DS-VTFET design aligns with the International Technology Roadmap for Semiconductors (ITRS), which aims to achieve high-performance and low-power applications in the semiconductor industry.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a low-power, high-efficiency 4-stage Dickson charge pump using CNTFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The article presents a CNTFET-based Dickson charge pump that exhibits a high level of efficiency and low power consumption. The simulation was conducted using the CNTFET device model developed by Stanford University inside the Cadence Virtuoso platform. The application of the Dickson charge pump methodology facilitates the identification of several stages inside the charge pump, hence improving the efficiency of voltage conversion for a given input voltage while minimizing power consumption. The charge pump using carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (CNTFETs) exhibits higher efficiency and settling time compared to previously suggested charge pump designsIn the Dickson charge pump design using CNTFETs, an input voltage denoted as Vin is set to 50 millivolts (mV), while the load resistance is specified as 2 megaohms (2 MΩ). Whereas the charge pump's functioning yields an output voltage (Vout) of 358 millivolts (mV). The settling time for 1% is 105 ns, power conversion efficiency (PCE) is 54.82% and voltage conversion efficiency (VCE) is 82%. The CNTFET based Dickson charge pump has average peak input power consumption of 64.4 nW. This proposed charge pump is also better from other previous proposed charge pump in terms of PCE. The proposed CNTFET based charge pump has low power consumption and high PCE and because of this benefit this circuit can be used for renewable energy systems and biomedical systems.

articleTitle: A Compact Multiband IEEE Shaped Planar Antenna For Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: A multiband IEEE shaped compact planar antenna is proposed in this paper which supports four bands at center frequencies of 2.4GHz (2.37-2.42GHz), 3.6GHz (3.54-3.61GHz), 7.4GHz (7.32-7.49GHz), and 9.2GHz (9.12-9.24) for applications like Wi-Fi, WiMAX, satellite, and military radar communication. A 50Ω microstrip line is used to feed the proposed antenna. The substrate of this antenna is FR-4 material having dielectric constant of 4.3 and is 0.2 mm thick. The patch, on the other hand, is made of copper. The optimized dimension of this antenna is 10×20×0.2mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. CST Microwave Studio software is used to simulate this proposed antenna. High value of 3dB beamwidth (146.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>), low side lobe level (-2.6dB), large front to back ratio (11.74) and high directivity (5.25dBi) make this antenna as an ideal candidate in this field.

articleTitle: Automatic Feeder System for Aqua Pond
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)

authors.preferredName: Nagadevara V S P Ravi Sumanth

abstract: In modern days, aqua farmers have faced many problems feeding their aquatic animals. The feeding of aquatic animals is based on a manual process. But by this manual feeding process, there is so much cost wasted for laborers. So, constant feeders are proposed in aqua farming. But there is a drawback to these constant feeders. Because more amount of the feed is dissipated in one place only. This paper proposes an automatic feeder system for aqua farming, which is designed to improve the efficiency of feeding and productivity of fish farming. The system utilizes the control unit that starts the motor, it rotates in the pond and dispenses the right amount of feed thus reducing the need for manual feeding, saving labor costs, and minimizing feed wastage, improving the health and growth of the aquatic animals. The proposed automatic feeder system is a cost-effective and efficient solution for aqua farming. It offers a reliable and flexible approach to fish/shrimp feeding. The automatic feeder system is an innovative solution so it can perform enhances operations in aqua farming. The system is easy to install and operate and can be customized to suit different aqua farming needs.

articleTitle: Deciphering Solar Potential and Sustainability-A Comparative Study of Indian Subcontinent
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: India is experiencing an energy crisis due to the constraints of its current coal-based power plants. Considering the increasing demand for power, India needs to develop new and sustainable techniques for generating electricity. Many researchers are working to find alternative approaches of producing electricity without distressing the environment. Solar energy represents a potential solution to this enigma. Indian subcontinent is largely blessed with solar energy. The average value of solar irradiation incident is around 5,000 trillion kWh per year energy. One such method to extract this energy is to mount roof-mounted solar panels on the open roof tops of significant structures. Motivated by the increasing penetration of SPV plants, this paper illustrates the design of solar based DG according to the load requirement and SPV injection into the grid at four different locations of the Indian subcontinent. A comprehensive comparative analysis of the incurred loss percentage and performance ratio of the proposed SPV model at each geographic location has been detailed.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Single Phase Preventer for Three Phase Induction Motor using Neutral Star Clamped Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The protection method for single-phase failures against three-phase induction motors is proposed in this study. The induction motor’s safety is the primary reason for choosing this topic. Induction motors are very sensitive to power quality issues such as over voltage, under voltage, S-L-G, LL-G, LLL-G faults. Out of the different faults as said above the most common fault is S-L-G. Most of the protective schemes that are used for the protection of Induction motor against S-L-G fault are based on the negative phase sequence topology. However, it is observed that due to saturation in the transformer core, the master trip relay 51 usually takes 50 cycles or 1 s to trip the circuit breaker. It also requires a DC Power supply for its operation. To overcome this requirement, a prototype has been developed for the protection of three phase induction motor against SL-G fault. The novelty of the scheme is that there is no requirement for a DC supply and the system has a faster response. The supply to the proposed circuit is from the three-phase mains and the tripping time for faults is under 30 cycles as against 50 cycles in negative sequence relay-based circuits. The simulation results are obtained from MATLAB/SIMULINK. On a 3-phase induction motor, the prototype is tested.

articleTitle: Experimental investigations and simulation studies on torque control using an advanced proportional-integral based controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In this paper, a proportional-integral controller named AFO-PI (adaptive fraction order-proportional integral) was designed for torque control of induction motor. The dynamics of the induction motor are identified using a linear parameter transfer function (LPTF).The parameters considered for designing the AFO-PI controllerwere designed using gain cross over frequency (ω<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gc</inf>), phase margin (φ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> ), and velocity error constant (K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</inf>). A refinement to the designed AFO-PI controller is carried out using a mathematical approach. To realize the (K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</inf>) specification, an approximation method, namely, Oustaloup recursive, is implemented. From the study, it was observed that AFO-PI outperforms PI.

articleTitle: Implementation of Routing-denser PnR Flow for an Efficient IC Block Level Design
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper presents Place and Route (PnR) flow for a block level design by setting a target for routing density. The PnR flow includes the placement of standard cells and routing of interconnects between them. Routing density is a key factor in determining the performance and reliability of the design, as it affects the signal propagation and timing constraints. In this project, a target routing density will be set based on the design requirements, and the PnR flow will be optimized to achieve this density while meeting the design constraints. The flow will be implemented using industry-standard EDA tools and validated on a testbench to ensure its functionality and performance. The proposed flow can be used as a basis for designing complex digital circuits and systems with high-performance requirements.

articleTitle: Automated Remote Sensing Image Classification using Enhanced Fireworks Algorithm with Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Remote Sensing Image (RSI) classification had a crucial role in different applications, like environmental monitoring, land cover mapping, and disaster management. Conventional classification methods frequently depend on manual parameter tuning and handcrafted features that can be less effective and time-consuming in capturing complicated patterns in RS data. Currently, DL methods have shown incredible performance in image classification tasks. Still, the challenges lie in optimizing the deep learning (DL) method and choosing the optimal hyper parameters for attaining the optimal classification accuracy. In this article, we devise an Automated Remote Sensing Image Classification using Enhanced Fireworks Algorithm with Deep Learning (ARSIC-EFWADL) model. In the presented ARSIC-EFWADL method, a four-stage process is followed. Initially, the median filtering (MF) approach is used to preprocess the images. Secondly, the ARSIC-EFWADL technique uses a densely connected networks (Densenet) model for feature extraction. Next, the EFWA is used for the parameter tuning process. At last, Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) methodology is implemented for classification purposes. To exhibit the improvised classification results of the ARSIC-EFWADL method, wide-ranging simulations were involved. The outcomes of the experiments inferred the enhanced performance of the ARSIC-EFWADL method over compared approaches under several evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: EPA To Regulate The Energy Consumption at the Facility-A Real Time Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Energy is the driving force for any action. It has to be utilized in an optimized manner so as to sustain the long term existence of its primary source. To achieve this, unwanted generation and its utilization must be avoided to the extent possible. Energy performance assessment is one of the major path through which the energy consumption pattern can be understood and its utilization can be regulated so as to achieve its sustainability objective. Building sector is one of the prime energy consumption sector which needs to be focused so as to regulate the energy consumption. In this paper energy performance assessment at one of the premier educational institutions located at Lat. 13.62°N; Long. 79.29°E; Alt. 226 M and consisting 10 buildings, 41 floors and 455 rooms is performed to estimate the total energy consumption of the facility both grid and captive power generation month wise over a period of two-years during 2021-2022. The following energy performance indices terms EPI, AAHEPI, PPC, ILER and LPD are evaluated to identify the areas of energy wastage and estimate energy regulating potential in the institute central facilities. Measures have been suggested to effectively improve the efficiency of energy use.

Author Keywords: Average annual hourly energy performance index (AAHEPI)

articleTitle: High Voltage Gain DC-DC Boost Converter for Fuel Cell Fed EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This study evaluates a 1.26 kW fuel cell-powered electric vehicle system using a high-power DC-DC boost converter and a neural network-based maximum power point finding algorithm. The importance of electric vehicles in today’s life is of great importance in order to achieve a pollution-free environment. One of the main causes of environmental pollution is transportation, caused mainly by internal combustion engines made from crude oil. In this study, an electric vehicle powered by a 1.26 kW proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) was designed using the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Integration of PEMFCs with brushless DC (BLDC) motors features specially configured high-power boost converters designed for high static converter voltage gain. The performance of the electric vehicle was evaluated using fuzzy logic controller (FLC) and neural network-based maximum power point finding control system. The results obtained were compared with different fuels, different temperatures and times.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of D-Q Current Control Techniques for Single-phase Inverter Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The paper proposes a DQ current controller for regulating the output power of a single-phase grid-connected VSI. The proposed controller generates the orthogonal component of grid current without introducing additional dynamics or distortions to the control loop, and is not dependent on system parameters. Compared to conventional orthogonal signal generation techniques, the proposed method exhibits better steady-state and dynamic performance, making it suitable for smart inverter applications that require advanced grid functionalities in compliance with revised standards. To demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy, the controller is applied to a 500 Watts, 110V, and 50Hz single-phase grid-connected VSI and validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: An Advanced Multimodal Navigation Perception System for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Technological innovation continues to advance at a rapid pace, enhancing and streamlining people's lives. The Secure navigation of surroundings and upholding a sense of independence provide considerable obstacles to the visually handicapped. Visually impaired People have trouble detecting barriers in their path, when strolling down the street, which causes it hazardous. The development and implementation of a multimodal navigation system with the goal of enhancing accessibility and independence for people having visual impairments are the main topics of this research. In order to provide the user with real-time information about the environment, the suggested system integrates a number of technologies, including computer vision, sensor fusion, localization, and haptic feedback methods. In this paper, we propose a solution called Visually Impaired, which uses interdisciplinary fields like software engineering, gadget design, and health science to help visually impaired people explore quickly and confidently by using ultrasonic waves to track nearby obstacles and alert them with a signal speech warning message and buzzer. Smart multimodal navigation perception system with an ultrasonic sensor that can detect stairs and other obstacles in its path to the front left, and right. Within a range of 0 to 30 cm, impediments are detectable. This project's use of an ultrasonic sensor is crucial. GPS stands for Global Positioning System. It has been made simpler for a blind person to use Google Maps to find a lost person thanks to the use of GSM modules and Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) technology. The smart stick is affordable, quick to react, power-efficient, and portable. This smart stick makes it easy for blind people to move from one location to another.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Management System in Micro Grid Operations, Load Support, and Control Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Demand for clean, high-quality, low-cost electricity has increased during the last decade. Traditional power generation and transmission systems are less popular due to high prices and poor environmental repercussions. Careful incorporation of RES can make them clean. Users' electricity use changes throughout the day. They must be able to fulfill demand, which means having enough power-producing capacity and infrastructure. This is a big cost. The money they earn will be based on actual consumer electricity use. In general, electricity is generated in stages, with a constant base load. To meet fluctuating demand, more stages of electricity generation are brought online throughout the day. This type of management is called supply-side management. Theoretically, reducing peak demand and the difference between peak and base load might reduce production capacity and grid infrastructure requirements, lowering costs for utilities and, eventually, customers. Demand-side management (DSM) is a management strategy. This study uses Simulink to mimic a small-scale smart grid. A fuzzy logic-based smart controller is being developed to govern the charging and discharging of an electric car battery, resulting in a more manageable and balanced load for the grid. The day's electricity consumption with and without the smart controller is compared. Modern pricing mechanisms result in lower peak demand, a smoother load curve for the grid, and lower per-kilowatt electricity costs.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Improving Inertia Control With Grid-Connected Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The proportion of power generation from Renewable Energy Sources (RES) has been greatly expanded in recent years. Power electronic inverter usage has been inevitable in power networks alongside improvements in renewable energy sources (RES). The kinetic energy generated in the synchronous generator (SG) has a considerable impact on the inertial response in a conventional power system. Due to the less damping system oscillations in the synchronous machine, RES often maintains low inertia and it continues to decrease. Due to a reduction in inertia, grid operators struggle to maintain frequency stability. Under frequency transitions, the low inertia phenomena in a weak grid create two major difficulties. The grid operators have identified the first difficulty as a high rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) that could trip a protective relay. Large frequency deviations may result in load shedding and cascading failure, which poses a second problem. To cope up with this, a Super Capacitor (SC), which is a power storage device, can be used to produce inertia for enhance frequency control. To regulate the ROCOF and frequency deviations in applications of low inertia grid, this paper aims to employ an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) technique. A comparative analysis of results of conventional emulated inertia control, fuzzy based inertia control with proposed ANN technique is carried out to assess the efficacy of the proposed controller

articleTitle: Support Vector Regression Framework for Reactive Power Prediction based on Real Power Demand
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Reactive power demand prediction is crucial for maintaining the stability, efficiency, and reliability of electrical power systems. While active power is responsible for performing useful work, reactive power is necessary for establishing and maintaining electromagnetic fields in inductive and capacitive devices. Accurate prediction of reactive power demand serves multiple purposes. One significant aspect is maintaining system stability. Fluctuations in reactive power demand can result in voltage variations, which can disrupt the operation of electrical equipment and lead to system instability. By predicting reactive power demand accurately, power system operators can proactively adjust voltage levels to ensure they remain within acceptable limits, thus improving the overall stability of the system. In this paper an attempt has been made to predict reactive power demand based on real power demand and load. A Matlab based model analysis of 55 house hold load has been taken into consideration for analysis.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of single stage Step-up converter for Photovoltaic applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Main novelty of the proposed work is dual leg single stage DC-AC converter for DC\AC grid and solar based applications. Operating principles, components design and modulation techniques are presented. Initially proposed concept is simulated in MATLAB Simulink platform and after validated in a real time prototype model is the future work. Proposed idea has some advantages like few passive components, less leakage current due to few switching frequency components, wide range voltage with absence of DC link capacitor. High efficiency due to single stage operation so this circuit is highly suitable for high\low voltage photo-voltaic energy conversion. Electromagnetic interference also less with continuous current.

articleTitle: Switched Capacitor based Multi Output DC-DC Converter for Low Voltage Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This work outlines the single input multi output(SIMO) switched capacitor based DC-DC converter is used for low power integrated circuit (IC) applications. The DC power source is essential for running the electronics equipment and its integrated circuits embedded for low power applications. The most popular kind of DC-DC converters are switched capacitor converters (SCC). A DC-DC converter's function is to convert an inadequately specified or fluctuating supply of DC voltage into a predetermined and steady output voltage for the applications. It goes without saying that designing an SCC with a significant quantity of target voltages spaced at high precision throughout the area of interest and thus increasing efficiency is both required and tremendously useful. At present, SCC topologies with binary resolution are given special emphasis. This work presents a single input multi outputs (SIMO) switched capacitor convertor topology that uses a minimal amount of switches and capacitors. Thirteen dual output voltage conversion ratios are delivered by the proposed multi output SCC without the need of any magnetic components like inductors or transformers. The PSIM software tool is utilized to validate the simulation findings of the proposed SIMO SCC.

articleTitle: H-MOCNA: Hierarchical Multi-Objective Composite Navigating Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks for Portable Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Focusing on cluster-based portable wireless sensor networks (CPWSN) may be a good idea for researchers. The sole reason CPWSN has been used in practical applications is due to the accessibility of low-cost Sensor nodes. For the past 10 years, the majority of academics apprehended the belief that WSNs were composed of uniform, stationary sensor nodes. As a result of the sensor nodes are heterogeneity and mobility, new energy-efficient solutions are needed to extend the lifetime of the network. We have introduced the Hierarchical Multi-Objective Composite Navigating technique (H-MOCNA), a brand-new MWSN routing technique. H-MOCNA uses hierarchical clustering. By using a pricing mechanism created on several systems of measurement, such as Mean Resource Utilization, regulation Overhead, Respond Period, Linking Reliability Measure, as well as HOPs, data packets are routed to the sink by H-MOCNA. The authors examine the implications of sensor node flexibility and power variety in H-MOCNA. The recreation’s results show how effective H-MOCNA is. H-MOCNA was used to imitate and contrast DyMORA, SHRP and EEHC. H-MOCNA reduces the mean energy usage by 7.06%, 8.34%, respectively, when compared to DyMORA, SHRP and EEHC. In regards to Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR), H-MOCNA performs better than SHRP, EEHC and DyMORA through 9.50% 8.62% than 7.9%, correspondingly.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis of Ion Incidence on the SJ_IGBT in Radiation Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In paper, we have investigated and analyzed the single event gate rupture (SEGR) on the Insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) where the heavy ion strikes on the device at normal and oblique incidence on the mid-point of the gate. It was observed that with use of combination of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (10nm/173nm) stacking as gate dielectrics, device shows better results towards the SEGR. In the proposed device both normal and oblique ions were incident. Strike field values have been observed at different values of LET that have shown for the normal and oblique ion strike. Ion penetration with different energy level of LET value has been investigated and it has revealed that device had robust performance up to LET= 98 Mev.cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/mg at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CE</inf> = 100 eV. The above proposed device has investigated under both normal and oblique ion incident. It has been revealed that the proposed device have better performance capability in the high radiation environment.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Technology for Power System Security using Condition Number
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Block chain technology secures electricity generation, transmission, and distribution. Contingency analysis helps assess and improve power system security. Contingency analysis predicts transmission line failure, equipment failure, and other disturbances to ensure energy system reliability. The power system security study, including assessment and augmentation, will use a lot of data from contingency analysis. Contingency analysis predicts transmission line failure, equipment failure, and other disturbances to ensure energy system reliability. The system's operation and maintenance depend on contingency analysis data. To make good decisions, public officials require these facts. This article proposes using blackchain technology for contingency analysis and data sharing. By modifying gearbox system characteristics, the condition number will improve power system controllability, stability, and transfer. Blockchain can protect power system data and ensure an uninterrupted power supply. The Python programmed developed and MATLAB software is used to generate the data under contingency condition. In this case UPSEB 75 bus system is considered for the study.

articleTitle: A Design on Rotor Flux Barrier for Line Start Synchronous Reluctance Motor for Enhancing Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In response to the growing demand in EV’s and industries for energy-efficient and eco-friendly solutions, the Line Start Synchronous Reluctance Motor (LSSRM/LS-SynRM) has emerged as a compelling candidate to fulfill these requirements. It is an innovative electric motor that combines the advantageous characteristics of synchronous motors and induction motors. Also, high efficiency compared to existing induction motors and permanent magnet motors. However, modern industrial drive applications need high power factor and efficiency, but LS-SynRM has produced less power factor and efficiency due to improper rotor structure effects the saliency characteristics. Therefore, this paper proposed four rotor flux barriers with optimized geometry to improve the performance of the motor. In addition, different types of rotor flux barrier with increasing flux barrier are discussed. This topology is developed and validated through the Ansys electronics suite. The simulation results analyze flux distribution, magnetic flux linkage, inductance profile, torque, and power. This suggests that the proposed model achieved maximum efficiency of 96.90 % and is suitable for industrial applications.

articleTitle: An Energy-efficient Method of Distributing Clock signals for System-on-Chip (SoC) using Current-mode Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Today's microprocessors use millions of transistors to process high-complexity data at clock frequencies of several gigahertz. The low power clock distribution operation is essential to a microprocessor's overall performance. New approaches to clocking circuitry are required due to the constantly rising power density and speed, as the traditional methods have significant shortcomings in modern VLSI processors. The distribution of the clock network dissipates a portion of the microprocessor's overall dynamic power consumption. The global wire delay and power consumption are confirmed to play a significant role in the realization of high performance System on chips as technology advances. Instead of relying on the technology solutions now being used to solve this issue, new circuit design methodologies must be developed. In this work delay and power of the global interconnects are optimised using low swing approach. This study employs a transmitter and receiver circuit based on current mode (CM) signaling to construct a clock distribution network within a SOC. The use of CM signalling as compare to voltage-mode (VM) has been proven to reduce propagation time by a factor of three theoretically. The utilization of CM signaling shows reduction in power consumption by 47% over conventional VM at 1 GHz frequency. All the circuits of this work are constructed using 90 nm CMOS technology and 1 V supply voltage.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Quadruped Robot for achieving Multi-Terrain Locomotion
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The "Quadruped Robot" project aims to provide an affordable and unmanned locomotory device which mimics the natural moment of a crawler, and which is easily portable with modular attachment and so much more. The proposed device is designed to resemble a spider structure with just 4 legs and uses an Arduino Uno and a metal gear motor driver mounted on an in-house fabricated parts with integrated Wi-Fi module for remote control through IOT cloud. The device comprises a four-legged spider imitating robot that can traverse uneven terrain and a camera which is wirelessly integrated with a communication and transmission system. The device is cost-effective, efficient, modular, and easy to transport, making it accessible to countries with low economic structures. The proposed system provides an asset through being useful in use cases like multi terrain exploration, Unmanned border monitoring, Defense uses and also can be used in multiple other use cases with modular attachments like robotic arm, lidar, etc. The device’s ability to blend in with the environment makes it an effective cheaper device for multipurpose use cases.

articleTitle: Back Calculation Anti-Windup Strategy for the Pitch Control of a Launch Vehicle Autopilot
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Windup phenomenon in a controller forces the actuation system into saturation, driving the system out of control. For a launch vehicle, the effect of saturation arising from thrust misalignment is discussed here. A third order dynamical model of a launch vehicle in pitch plane is considered and for command tracking, a state feedback controller with integrator is designed. To study the effect of saturation, the system is given an initial thrust misalignment and the response of the system states and control signals are studied. Finally anti-windup compensators are designed to recover desired tracking performance.In this work, Integrator Limit Approach (ILA) and the Back Calculation Anti-Windup (BCAW) Strategy are developed and evaluated on the basis of performance specifications like steady state error, settling time and peak overshoot.

articleTitle: Optimization in PFSCL Design Using Floating-Gate MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This work suggests a FGMOS-based efficient exclusive-OR (XOR) gate design for PFSCL. The pull-down transistor is changed to a FGMOS transistor in the proposed design, which eliminates the pull-down transistor threshold voltage and reduces the overall voltage supply demand by a factor of the threshold voltage. The effectiveness of the proposed PFSCL XOR gate design and the already existing triple tail cell-based design were compared. Through a number of SPICE simulations using 45nm PTM CMOS technology parameters, the functionality of both designs was confirmed.

articleTitle: An approach for automatically solving handwritten equations using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The mathematical description of two things that are equal—one on each side of an "equals" sign—is called an equation. Equations help us address problems in our daily lives. Other fields that employ mathematical equations include medical, aerospace, traffic control, etc. In this paper, we have proposed a deep learning-based approach to solving handwritten equations in a digital system. We have only attempted to solve algebraic or arithmetic equations. The accuracy achieved while testing the application with expressions and equations was observed to be 90%. To solve equations received from the image scanned, we have proposed the use of a string extraction and manipulation method to convert the handwritten tedious equations into an expression that can be solved easily using a computer or digital system.

articleTitle: Face Verification System for Age-Invariance using Deep Convolution Neural Network(CNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: There has been remarkable research progress made in the area of face recognition and it is been used in a wide range of applications from personal logins, security checks, attendance systems, etc., The progression of age reflects the facial features and this remains a great challenge while performing face recognition when matching is made with images of a large age gap. This paper proposes a robust face recognition technique invariant of the ages. The proposed system adapts the Deep Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) considering the matching of faces irrespective of the ages. Unlike other face recognition systems, the proposed system estimates the age and creates an Age-Invariant Face Representation using deep feature learning, where the features that are less affected by age-related changes like the texture Descriptors and the appearance-based features are extracted. This representation is used by the classification/matching step to perform recognition. The CACD data set is utilized to carry out the task of training and testing the algorithm. The system is verified to get robust results and when compared with the existing system provides an accuracy of 98.01% and the Rank-1 Accuracy of 88.21%.

articleTitle: Respiratory Diseases Detection Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Respiratory diseases pose significant challenges to public health and individuals worldwide. These diseases affect the respiratory system, including the lungs, airways, and other related structures. This research paper presents a comparative analysis of DenseNet121, ResNet50, and Inception V3 models for multi-classification of diseases using input chest X-ray images. This study focuses on the classification of Pneumonia, COVID-19, Tuberculosis (TB), and Healthy images. A comprehensive Kaggle dataset of the chest X-ray images representing these classes is utilized for training and evaluation. The models are trained using model checkpoints to save the best-performing model weights and reduce the learning rate to improve convergence. Performance metrics accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are computed to assess the effectiveness of the models in accurately classifying the chest X-ray images. The results and comparative analysis highlight the strengths and weaknesses of each model for disease classification. The findings demonstrate the importance of model checkpoints and learning rate reduction techniques in achieving optimal performance. This research contributes to the field of automated disease detection in chest X-ray analysis, providing insights into the effectiveness of deep learning models and the significance of specific training strategies.

articleTitle: Integrated Fertilizer Recommendation and Crop Management System for Farmers
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper proposes an IoT-based Fertilizer Recommendation system that can send the data from the soil testing kit directly to the ThingSpeak platform. An application named Earthworm has been developed which can access and retrieve data for the prediction of desired fertilizer based onthe nutrient values provided by the testing kit. This application(web app) can provide multiple features like a request for soil testing and drone service, a demo video on how to use the app, achatbot, and a purchase link for buying the recommended fertilizer. The low-cost, compact-sized, soil testing kit has been provided with a hybrid power supply model which enhances itsflexibility of usage.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Slotted Antenna with a strip of Inverted L-shape for S-Band and WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: A slotted antenna of dual-band in nature having a planar structure has been proposed in this manuscript in which feeding is accomplished by microstrip transmission line having a L-shaped strip of inverted in nature is embedded in rectangular slotted portion in the grounded plane of the antenna. The proposed antenna produces resonances at the two frequencies-centrals of 3.48 GHz and 5.20 GHz with the bandwidths of percentage of 7.76 and 19.58 respectively which is appropriate for usage in S-band and WLAN. The gains of simulation at the two central frequency of resonance are 2.71 dBi and 2.87 dBi respectively. The antenna exhibits stable patterns of radiation at 3.48 GHz and 5.20 GHz.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Prediction Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Predicting crop production using information about the environment, soil, water, and crops themselves is an area ripe for investigation. Deep learning-based models often extract crop attributes for prediction. These techniques have the following drawbacks: The quality of the extracted characteristics substantially affects the efficacy of those models, and there is no simple non-linear or linear mapping between raw data and crop production estimates. Deep RL guides and inspires to compensate. Deep reinforcement learning uses RL and DL to accurately forecast agricultural yields from raw data. A Deep Recurrent Q-Network model predicts agricultural yield. This model uses Q-Learning reinforcement learning and a Recurrent Neural Network deep learning algorithm. Data parameters feed the Recurrent Neural network's layers. Q-learning networks forecast agricultural yields from data. Q-values are linear mappings from Recurrent Neural Network output values. A threshold and parametric features help the reinforcement learning agent predict crop productivity. Finally, the agent is awarded a final score that takes into account the steps taken to both reduce error and improve forecast accuracy. By maintaining the original data distribution, the suggested model efficiently predicts the crop production with an accuracy of 93.7%, exceeding competing models.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Techniques in Digital Diagnostic System for Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Digital diagnostic system (DDS) for lung cancer (LC) discovery can advantage from the utilize of Natural Language Processing (NLP) procedures. In arrange to create organized data that will be utilized for assurance, NLP can offer help remove information from unstructured data sources, such as electronic prosperity records and helpful reports. In this paper, advanced symptomatic devices for LC location are talked about that can increment the exactness and speed of analyze whereas diminishing the workload of specialists and therapeutic experts by utilizing NLP methods. Free-text information, such as persistent depictions of their side effects, can be processed utilizing NLP calculations to supply organized information that can be analyzed. The data from therapeutic reports, such as radiology reports, can be extricated utilizing NLP and changed into organized information for think about. In expansion to information preparing, NLP methods can too be utilized for data recovery and choice bolster. NLP can be utilized to look huge databases of restorative information, such as PubMed and Medline, to recover relevant information for conclusion. NLP can moreover be utilized to supply choice back to specialists, by displaying pertinent data and cases from the case base when diagnosing patients with LC. NLP procedures have the potential to revolutionize the way computerized demonstrative frameworks for LC location work. These frameworks can decrease the workload of specialists and restorative experts while increasing the exactness and speed of diagnostics by utilizing NLP.

articleTitle: Modern Islanding Detection Techniques for DG Integrated Power Systems: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Renewable energy sources are widely employed on the distribution network grid to fulfil the rising demand for electrical energy and to alleviate the global warming catastrophe caused due to conventional energy sources. As a result, the use of dispersed energy sources is increasing. By virtue of low carbon emissions, high efficiency and high-power quality in the electrical power system, the distributed system benefits from having a high penetration of distributed generating resources. Unintentional islanding happens when the main utility's power supply is interrupted due to various factors, yet the distribution network's power supply is maintained by DG. And it is one of the primary challenges with these Distributed generators (DG) system integrations. To minimize harm to the electrical equipment, grid protection interference, and human safety issues, efficient islanding detection and fast detachment of DG are essential. Several investigations have been undertaken in order to minimize the difficulty of detecting islanding. With a brief overview, this paper provides a outlined evaluation of several Modern Islanding Detection Techniques (IDTs), covering both signal processing & intelligent IDTs.

articleTitle: Dynamic Power Managment and Control Strategy for LVDC Microgrid Using Modified droop control technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Fault current clearing in a dc microgrid has proved difficult because of the lack of a natural zero crossing and the rapid spike in dc current during a fault. The fault current is high in pole-to-pole faults. It is significantly larger when numerous dc generators are present since all the generators input the greatest feasible current into a network during the incident. This causes extremely high currents in the lines. In this instance, the dc breaker has to break an excessive fault current to clear the problem. However, operating a dc breaker at a high fault current level is difficult and dangerous. Therefore, this study presents a control approach for dc-dc converters that reduces the fault current level, ensuring every dc break operation is efficient and secure. It makes use of an auxiliary current control loop that is engaged during a fault occurrence. This updated control method guarantees that the current sent into the network by the converter is low during the failure, leading in reduced currents on the lines in the network. A comprehensive simulation is used to validate the suggested control method.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Detection using MobileNet Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Rice is a crucial cereal crop worldwide, consumed by more than half of the global population as a primary energy source. The productivity and value of rice grains are affected by various biotic and abiotic issues, including pests, soil fertility, precipitation, temperature, and diseases caused by bacteria and viruses. Farmers invest significant time and resources in disease management, often relying on manual visual detection methods that can lead to ineffective farming practices. However, technological advancements in agriculture have led to the development of automatic identification methods for infectious organisms in rice plant leaves. The study utilized a pre-trained deep convolutional neural network known as MobilNet, implementing a transfer learning approach to identify three significant diseases that commonly affect rice plants: Bacterial leaf blight, Brown spot, and Leaf smut. To accomplish this objective, the transfer learning model underwent fine-tuning using diverse hyperparameters and attained an accuracy rate of 87% after running for 100 epochs. The goal of this research is to precisely categorize plant leaves based on their respective disease classifications, enabling early detection and preventive measures against plant diseases.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement in Grid Connected Hybrid Distributed Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Renewable energy (RE) sources solar as well as wind are the two essential energy sources found free of cost in nature. It has been used from past few decades to generate electricity and minimized the use of conventional sources of energy to save the environment. Analyzing the environmental conditions suppose there are conditions like power cut, no sun, no wind to generate electricity from hybrid, then there can be a substitute as fuel cell. Therefore, the contemporary methodology involves the control operation to fulfill the initial requirements of hybrid system maximum power tracing, input DC voltage & exchange amongst the RE sources transported to interlink. Proposed system is a fusion of three sources of energy i.e., photo-voltaic (PV), wind (WECS) and fuel cell (FC) hybrid system which gives efficient power compared with PV/wind hybrid. The power oscillations for an interlink could be condensed by Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Interference method (ANFIS) based maximum power point tracking (MPPT) system. In this paper the hybrid system is compared with Incremental Conductance method (ICM) with Hill climb search (HCS) principle linked to ANFIS controller and fuel cell (ICM-HCS ANFIS & FC), without MPPT controller and without ANFIS controller. The proposed system satisfies the objectives required using a software called MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation results substantiates the power generated in proposed system & gives efficient power with dwindled total harmonic distortion (THD).

articleTitle: Achieving Covertness in the Wireless Mode-based Communication in the IoT Connection with use of THZ Band and AWGN Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: If covert communication is employed, an opponent might not be conscious of the communication taking place intermediary to the 2 users. This study investigates covert wireless mode-based interactions in a thickly distributed IoT connection wherein 1 IoT gadget experiences noise from the background as well as combined interference caused by remaining Tx devices. Communication with covertness gets challenging in a network of IoT devices using THz (Terahertz) Band because Willie can effortlessly place a receiving medium in the tiny beam separating Bob and Alice to detect or prohibit their LOS links. We demonstrated that communication with covertness remains viable in this circumstance by making use of diffuse scattering or reflection from a surface that’s rough. With regards to the security of the physical layer, communication with covertness could increase the security of the IoT connection from the bottom layer up. Between 300 and 350 GHz is the lowest frequency range that can be used in a covert environment without having any negative effects on covert communications. The effect will be exponentially grown as we reduce the frequency ranges, which will be validated via the simulation and its outcomes.

articleTitle: Voltage stability enhancement based optimal reactive power control
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Power system networks are exposed to various environmental and economic challenges that can have a detrimental impact on their stability and capacity to provide a consistent power supply, particularly in developing countries. The voltage stability monitoring is crucial for the system's status and capability to provide an uninterrupted power supply. Delayed responses to voltage instability can significantly damage the power grid system, making it essential to take prompt and appropriate action to mitigate voltage instability and ensure the system's safe and efficient operation. This paper proposes two approaches to enhance the stability of power systems. A neural network employing feedforward backpropagation to detect the critical bus in the IEEE 9-bus system based on Voltage Stability Index Lmn and loadability Index. The FFBPNN identifies the critical bus prone to voltage collapse in the power system, trained using a backpropagation algorithm. The second approach utilizes an optimization technique based on Particle Swarm Optimization PSO to optimize the reactive power control of a Static Var Compensator SVC device through its size and location, where the SVC device considers a type of Flexible AC Transmission System FACT device. This approach minimizes the reactive power effect which causing of voltage instability during high load demand, improving the voltage stability of the system. The proposed method is evaluated under different load levels and network configurations and validated based on the Newton-Raphson method for optimal power flow analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of Battery Energy Storage System for an Energy Market within an LV Distribution Feeder
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This research paper evaluates the impact of a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) on an energy market within a low-voltage (LV) distribution feeder. Specifically, the paper investigates the potential benefits of using the BESS for peak shaving and energy shifting within an LV distribution feeder. A simulation model is developed to analyze the impact of the BESS on the energy market, considering different scenarios for solar PV capacities including existing and incremented. As well as Battery Energy Storage system aids in energy shifting which can be considered as a solution for the energy market’s night-time operation. The results show that the BESS can effectively reduce the grid utilization on the feeder, resulting in significant cost savings and improved grid stability. Moreover, the BESS can facilitate energy shifting by storing excess energy during off-peak periods and discharging it during peak periods, which can further reduce the reliance on expensive peaking power plants. Overall, the findings of this study demonstrate the potential of BESSs for improving the effectiveness of energy markets within LV distribution feeders.

articleTitle: Enhancing Speech Emotional Recognition through a Multi-Layer Perceptron Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Detecting emotions in audio speech files is a significant challenge for machines, despite the natural skill of humans in this area. While computers excel at comprehending informational content, deciphering underlying emotions remains a formidable challenge. At this juncture, the Speech Emotion Recognition System (SERS) emerges as an important component of the solution. To reliably categorize audio speech data into distinct emotional categories such as happiness, sorrow, anger, and neutrality, a specific model called SERS was developed. It has a wide range of potential uses, from healthcare to contact centers. In this study, the following Machine Learning models were utilized Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-nearest neighbors (KNN), and Decision Tree (DT). These models yielded lower accuracy rates when categorizing emotions. Thus, to improve the accuracy rate three crucial audio features such as Mel, chroma, and MFCC are applied by the constructed SERS and analyzed by utilizing a grid search-based Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifier for accurate results. The proposed model produced 75.97% accuracy rate, which is quite remarkable.

articleTitle: Industrial IoT: Overview, Enabled Technologies, Recent Case Studies & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) has attracted a lot of scientific researchers. IIoT is being developed as a result of the Internet of Things (IoT) applications and the implementation of modern technical developments. By integrating smart devices for monitoring, sensing, gathering, interpreting, communicating and processing real-time events in industrial systems, IIoT emerged as a potential vision of IoT in the manufacturing sector. The main goal of IIoT is to accomplish high level efficiency, improve productivity and effective organization of industrial processes and assets through automated monitoring, product customization, optimizing machineries, preventive and predictive preservation of manufacturing tools and equipment. The basic architecture of IIoT, its components, its application, key enable technologies and challenges are described in this paper. Some recent IIoT case studies that are part of the research are also discussed in this survey paper.

articleTitle: Single Axis Solar Tracking System Using 555 IC
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Growing need for energy and worries about the environment have made renewable energy resources an increasingly important alternatives to conventional power resources. With considerable ecological and economic prospects, the topic of green energy is quickly becoming one that is promising for countries. In spite of its enormous potential, solar power, particularly in agricultural areas, performs a crucial role as a major power resource. The project is split into two phases, with the hardware and software implementation of a system that uses a 555 IC with light detecting resistor Sensors for continuous tracking of sunlight being the primary focus of each phase. The servo motor and sensors have been linked to achieve optimal efficiency by following the path of the sun. In this project,one axis of a solar tracking gadget has been created in order to capture more solar energy. A 555IC has been employed as the primary controlling component in this project. To precisely determine where the sun is in the sky, the project uses dual LDRs. The solar panel is subsequently turned in the appropriate direction using the servomotor. The PV panel and servo motor are mechanically connected. By implementing a single-axis solar tracking system, the system optimizes the daily sun tracking, thereby enhancing the efficiency of the solar panel.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Perspective on Stochastic Dynamic Equations
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The advancement in the field of machine learning has led to the development of novel techniques for sparse learning of stochastic dynamic equations. This research aims to study the application of sparse learning techniques to model and predict the behavior of dynamic systems. The study focuses on evaluating the performance of various sparse learning algorithms, including LASSO, Ridge Regression, and Elastic Net, in modeling the dynamic behavior of a real-world system. The results of this study suggest that the LASSO algorithm is most suitable for sparse learning of stochastic dynamic equations, as it provides a good balance between accuracy and sparsity. The findings also highlight the significance of feature selection and variable importance in the modeling process. Furthermore, this study provides evidence for the need for scalability and flexibility in the development of sparse learning techniques for real-world applications.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Dynamic Routing Selection Algorithm for Extending the Lifespan of Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Data Attributes
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNET) always had the potential to be made up of an incredibly huge number of nodes providing a variety of services as computing devices get smaller and cheaper. By just assigning a small portion of their resources, such networks may carry out numerous activities concurrently. Alternately, a huge, unanticipated application may be carried out by a number of smaller wireless networks working together. In both situations, a different routing system from the one that is currently in use may increase the effectiveness of the job or application being conducted, lowering the network’s energy usage. To fully realize the promise of such networks, we contend that the latest directing architecture is necessary, an individual that enables dynamic swapping among various routing strategies in response to the needs of deployed applications, network circumstances as a whole, and location data. In this study, we demonstrate how a digital attribute-based cluster hierarchy overlaying sensor networks may accomplish dynamic routing scheme selection. We give the analytical findings for our plan and demonstrate the potential for improvement.

articleTitle: Speaker Identification Using MFCC Feature Extraction : A Comparative Study Using GMM, CNN, RNN, KNN and Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Speech recognition plays a major role in technology that enables computers and devices to understand and interpret human speech, while speaker identification is a specialized application within speech recognition that focuses on recognizing and distinguishing individual speakers based on their unique vocal characteristics. By utilizing techniques such as feature extraction, pattern recognition and machine learning algorithms speaker identification systems can match an input speech sample to a known set of speaker profiles and determine the most likely speaker’s identity. This process involves comparing the extracted features of the input speech with the features stored in a database or model. In this project we are performing a comparative study which mainly focuses on extracting features through MFCC feature extraction for all models in common and then the implementation of identifying speakers using Gaussian Mixture Model, CNN, LSTM in case of RNN, k-Nearest Neighbour and a Random Forest Classifier.A comparative study on various types of models helps us to pave way on analyzing these to implement one of the best among these in day to day life. Among all the models, GMM performed very well with an accuracy of 98.68% followed by LSTM with an accuracy of 95.77%.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled IoT (B-IoT): Overview, Security, Scalability & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In Internet of Things (IoT) several applications that call for the collecting and sharing of enormous amounts of data where the information security is a crucial problem. Blockchain technology is still being used in IoT applications, especially at the lower end of the computing spectrum. As a result, a number of issues and questions need to be resolved, and it is uncertain what the future will bring. The IoT operational architecture is centralized by design whereas blockchain has decentralized architecture, however, decentralized architecture enables scalable and effective communication between conventional and IoT equipment. Decentralization, distributed accounting, and point-to-point communication are among the characteristics of blockchain. Blockchain integration in IoT applications can enable services like availability, authentication, authorization and integrity. This study provides an overview of the literature on IoT and blockchain integration by looking at current research issues and trends in the use of blockchain-related methods and technologies in the context of security.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Engineering and Accelerating Learning through Intelligent Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The rapid growth of data and the increasing complexity of analytical tasks have necessitated the development of efficient data engineering processes and accelerated learning techniques. Intelligent data engineering and automated learning are two important fields in the domain of artificial intelligence. The aim of intelligent data engineering is to develop efficient and effective algorithms for processing large volumes of data. Automated learning, on the other hand, focuses on creating algorithms that can learn from data without being explicitly programmed. Both fields are closely related and have significantly contributed to the development of various applications such as machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics. Through a comprehensive review of data engineering concepts, challenges, and automated learning techniques, this paper highlights the benefits and advantages of incorporating intelligent automation into data engineering workflows. It presents case studies and real-world examples showcasing successful implementations of intelligent automation in data engineering projects. In addition, the paper discusses performance evaluation metrics, challenges, ethical considerations, and potential intelligent automation risks. In addition, it discusses future research and development opportunities in the disciplines of intelligent data engineering and automated learning. The findings of this study shed light on the potential of intelligent automation in augmenting data engineering processes and accelerating learning, thereby revealing new avenues for efficient data utilization and knowledge extraction across a variety of domains.

articleTitle: The Significance of Artificial Intelligence in Contemporary Cinema
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a potent force that is transforming numerous industries. AI technologies are revolutionizing the creation, production, and consumption of motion pictures. This study examines the impact of AI on narrative, production techniques, visual effects, and audience experiences in contemporary cinema. Filmmaking techniques have been revolutionized by AI technologies. It investigates AI applications in fields such as cinematography, editing, visual effects, and post-production, highlighting AI-powered tools and techniques that have improved efficiency, creativity, and visual aesthetics in contemporary cinema. The paper also discusses the broader implications of AI in the film industry, such as changes in production processes, economic implications, and its impact on film distribution, marketing, and audience targeting. Ethical and societal issues pertaining to AI-generated content are discussed, as is its impact on employment and job positions in the film industry. This study seeks to shed light on the opportunities, challenges, and implications of AI’s presence in the contemporary cinematic landscape by analyzing the integration of AI in these areas.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband MIMO Antennas: Latest Advances in Design and Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The exponential growth of digital platforms and the increasing user base in wireless communication has created a need for communication systems that can provide high data speeds, reliability, and strong transmission links. The limitations of single antenna systems have led to an increased focus on multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antennas in order to address the requirements of modern high-speed wireless systems. Nevertheless, the attainment of adequate isolation in compact 5G terminals presents certain obstacles. The primary objective of this review paper is to examine the fundamental aspects, performance metrics, and design methodologies pertaining to multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antennas. More specifically, the paper delves into the characteristics of dual-band, ultra-wideband (UWB), and circularly polarized antennas. The paper investigates several aspects of present MIMO antenna design procedures, including channel capacity loss (CCL), envelope correlation coefficient (ECC), gain, efficiency, and isolation approaches, in order to facilitate a comparative analysis. This research makes a valuable contribution to the progress of high-speed wireless communication systems by thoroughly understanding the merits and constraints of each strategy. The implementation of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) antennas shows potential for various wireless applications, encompassing portable devices, smart gadgets, automobiles, and wireless sensors.

articleTitle: Predicting Hospital Readmission Risk for Heart Failure Patients Using Machine Learning Techniques: A Comparative Study of Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Heart failure is a frequent cause of hospitalization and readmission because of the severity of the disease. Researchers explored using Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to forecast whether heart failure patients must be readmitted to the hospital. This study examines ML algorithms that use data from electronic health records to forecast hospital readmissions for patients with heart failure. We will assess the accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score of logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and artificial neural networks. The study's results will show how well ML algorithms predict heart failure patients' hospital readmission risk, which could lead to personalized therapies that improve patient outcomes and save healthcare costs. Comparing studies in this field shows gaps in model interpretability, generalizability, and socioeconomic determinants of health in prediction models.

articleTitle: Monitoring and controlling of Solar Driven Real Time Smart Energy Management System Integrated with IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The increasing population and technological advancements have contributed to a rise in overall energy demand, which has created significant challenges for energy management at the consumer level. Smart devices have emerged as essential tools for energy management systems that not only degree energy consumption precisely but also facilitate two-way communication, remote equipment control, and provide billing data and utilization information to users. Intelligent devices are essential components of smart power infrastructure, enabling the evaluation, estimation, supervision, deployment, and interactions of power distribution, usage, and demand at both the device and grid levels. However, technological advancements offer solutions to make energy management more manageable. The integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar PV, integrated with Internet of Things (IoT) can simplify the energy management system. The IoT device, such as the ESP32 controller, can collect data from voltage and current sensors and transfer it to the cloud. This efficient method monitors load behavior allows for effective load management and reduction of greenhouse gases. The deployment of this energy management system in every household can have a significant impact on reducing unwanted energy usage and effectively managing energy generation and supply. In this research work an IoT-based SEMS strategy is tested and implemented with a real time test case study integrated with IoT devices. The investigation of the scenario example demonstrates that the utilized IoT-based SEMS is effective in resolving the difficulties associated with energy management at the household level.
